title: clausena heptaphylla
intro: Clausena heptaphylla, commonly known as the Seven-leafed Clausena or Thai bitters, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. Clausena heptaphylla is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antiemetic, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Clausena heptaphylla include limonoids, coumarins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
